paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00001
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s009
paragraphs.text: MMVD is the most common heart disease of dogs in many parts of the world, accounting for approximately 75% of heart disease cases seen in dogs by veterinary practices in North America. It is estimated that approximately 10% of dogs presented to primary care veterinary practices have heart disease.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00002
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s009
paragraphs.text: The panel adopted the following scheme, adapted from the American Heart Association, to rate the strength of the recommendations in these guidelines.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00003
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s009
paragraphs.text: The panel chose to use a hybrid of the American Heart Association and Veterinary Emergency Critical Care RECOVER evidence grading criteria, as outlined below: In 2009, the consensus panel adapted a staging system for heart disease and heart failure. Then, in 2019, the consensus guidelines were updated to reflect an expanded staging scheme, linking clinical signs to appropriate treatments based on risk and level of evidence.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00004
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s017
paragraphs.text: Considered the weakest LOE based on experience of the panel.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00005
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s017
paragraphs.text: Based on quality studies which leave room for observation and discussion.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00006
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s017
paragraphs.text: This level of evidence is based on well-designed, controlled studies for interpretation by the reader.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00007
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s017
paragraphs.text: The highest level of evidence based on high quality studies generating a clear and statistically valid result.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00008
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s017
paragraphs.text: In 2009, the consensus panel adapted a staging system for heart disease and heart failure, and sought to link clinical signs to appropriate treatments at each stage.2 According to this approach, patients are expected to advance from one stage to the next stage.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00009

paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s020
paragraphs.text: Describes asymptomatic dogs that have no radiographic or echocardiographic evidence of cardiac remodeling in response to their MMVD Refers to asymptomatic dogs that have more advanced mitral valve regurgitation that meet clinical trial criteria used to identify dogs that clearly should benefit from initiating treatment to delay the onset of heart failure

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00011
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s026
paragraphs.text: Small breed dogs, including breeds with known predisposition to develop MMVD should undergo regular evaluations. RECOMMENDATIONS FOR DIAGNOSES Owners of breeding dogs or those at high risk may choose to participate in approved screening events.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00012
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s026
paragraphs.text: If evidence of a murmur or mitral regurgitation (MR) is identified, dogs should no longer be bred. No drug treatment. No dietary treatment.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00014
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s026
paragraphs.text: CLASS 1 CLASS 1 CLASS 1 CLASS 1 LOE: EXPERT OPINION LOE: EXPERT OPINION LOE: EXPERT OPINION LOE: EXPERT OPINION

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00015
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s027
paragraphs.text: RECOMMENDATIONS FOR DIAGNOSES Short axis basilar views and recently described 2-dimensional, long-axis echocardiographic ratios have proven to be effective for identifying left atrial and ventricular enlargement in dogs with MMVD.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00016
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s027
paragraphs.text: Echocardiography is to identify the cause of the murmur, answer specific questions regarding the severity of cardiac chamber enlargement, and identify comorbidities.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00017
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s027
paragraphs.text: Because of marked variation in thoracic conformation, in addition to using a vertebral heartscore, the use of the vertebral left atrial size (VLAS) may be beneficial.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00018
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s027
paragraphs.text: Having baseline radiographs at a time when the dog is asymptomatic can enhance the ability to differentiate cardiac from noncardiac causes of cough.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00019
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s027
paragraphs.text: Thoracic radiography in all patients at a time when the patient is asymptomatic for MMVD. Blood pressure measurement.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00021
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s027
paragraphs.text: CLASS 1 CLASS 1 CLASS 1 CLASS 1 CLASS 1 CLASS 1 LOE: EXPERT OPINION LOE: EXPERT OPINION LOE: EXPERT OPINION LOE: MODERATE LOE: STRONG LOE: MODERATE Describes asymptomatic dogs that have no radiographic or echocardiographic evidence of cardiac remodeling in response to their MMVD STAGE B1 Asymptomatic MMVD causing MR severe enough to result in cardiac remodeling, dogs in this category should meet the following criteria: STAGE B2 Treatment is not recommended in these dogs because at this early stage of disease, progression to heart failure is uncertain. No drug or dietary treatment. RECOMMENDATIONS FOR DIAGNOSES AND MONITORING Reevaluation by echocardiography is suggested (or radiography if echocardiography is unavailable) in 6-12 months.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00022
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s027
paragraphs.text: CLASS 1 CLASS 1 LOE: EXPERT OPINION RECOMMENDATIONS FOR DIAGNOSES • Murmur intensity >3/6 • Echocardiographic LA : Ao ratio in the right-sided short axis view in early diastole >1.6 • Left ventricular internal diameter in diastole, normalized for body weight (LVIDDN) >1.7 • Breed-adjusted radiographic vertebral heart score (VHS) >10.5 If only radiographic examination is possible, cardiomegaly may be diagnosed in cases where the VHS ≥11.5 and the vertebral left atrial size (VLAS) ≥3.01,2. If radiographic cardiomegaly does not meet both of these criteria, an echocardiogram should be performed prior to the initiation of therapy.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00023
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s027
paragraphs.text: LOE: STRONG LOE: EXPERT OPINION CLASS 1 VLAS values of >3 likely identify Stage B2 MMVD. LOE: MODERATE CLASS 1

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00024
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s028
paragraphs.text: CLASS 1 LOE: STRONG CLASS IIA CLASS IIA CLASS IIA LOE: WEAK LOE: WEAK LOE: MODERATE Pimobendan at a dosage of 0.25-0.3 mg/kg PO q12h.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00025
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s028
paragraphs.text: Surgical intervention in advanced Stage B2 is possible and recommended by some panelists. Dietary treatment.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00027
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s028
paragraphs.text: For patients in stage B2 on either initial examination, 5 (of 10) panelists recommend treatment with ACEI.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00028
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s028
paragraphs.text: Furosemide CRI (0.66-1 mg/kg/hour) for life-threatening pulmonary edema. LOE: MODERATE CLASS 1 RECOMMENDATIONS FOR DIAGNOSES

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00030
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s029
paragraphs.text: CLASS IIB CLASS I LOE: WEAK LOE: WEAK LOE: MODERATE CLASS 1 Analyze serum NT-proBNP concentration.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00031
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s029
paragraphs.text: Most symptomatic dogs with MMVD are middle-aged or older, and it is prudent to complete the clinical database.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00032
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s029
paragraphs.text: LOE: EXPERT OPINION CLASS 1 LOE: EXPERT OPINION Complete clinical database (including thoracic radiographs and ideally echocardiogram). CLASS 1 HOSPITAL- BASED CLASS 1 Torasemide at approximately 5% to 10% of the furosemide dosage (0.1-0.3 mg/kg q24h7). Pimobendan, 0.25-0.3 mg/kg administered PO q12h. ACEI (0.5 mg/kg PO q12h).

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00035
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s029
paragraphs.text: Furosemide 2 mg/kg IV (or IM) followed by 2 mg/kg IV (or IM) hourly until patient’s respiratory signs are substantially improved.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00036
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s029
paragraphs.text: LOE: EXPERT OPINION Oxygen supplementation, if needed, can be administered. CLASS I LOE: EXPERT OPINION CLASS IIA LOE: WEAK CHRONIC (HOME-BASED) Continue pimobendan, 0.25-0.3 mg/kg PO q12h. CLASS I LOE: STRONG LOE: MODERATE Continue PO furosemide (2mg/kg q12h). CLASS I Spironolactone (2.0 mg/kg PO q12 - 24 h).

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00037
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s029
paragraphs.text: Diltiazem (often combined with digoxin) in cases of complicated atrial fibrillation.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00038
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s029
paragraphs.text: LOE: MODERATE CLASS I LOE: MODERATE CLASS I Dietary recommendations: - Ensure adequate protein intake - Modestly restrict sodium intake - Omega-3-fatty acids LOE: MODERATE CLASS I In centers with low complication rates, patients benefit from surgical intervention to repair their mitral valve apparatus. Continue or start ACEI (0.5 mg/kg PO q12h). None of the panelists routinely use nitroglycerin.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00041
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s029
paragraphs.text: LOE: MODERATE CLASS I LOE: WEAK CLASS IIB LOE: EXPERT OPINION CLASS III Refers to dogs with end-stage MMVD, in which clinical signs of heart failure are refractory to standard treatment STAGE D RECOMMENDATIONS FOR DIAGNOSES

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00042
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s030
paragraphs.text: CHF involves the same diagnostic steps outlined for Stage C plus the finding of failure to respond to treatments outlined in the Stage C guidelines. Chronic PO furosemide dosages > -8 mg/kg q24h in any dosing regimen to maintain patient comfort in the face of appropriate dosages of pimobendan, an ACEI, and spironolactone indicate disease progression to Stage D.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00043
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s030
paragraphs.text: HOSPITAL- BASED Pimobendan dosage may be increased (off-label use) to include a third 0.3 mg/kg daily PO dose.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00044
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s030
paragraphs.text: LOE: EXPERT OPINION LOE: EXPERT OPINION LOE: EXPERT OPINION CHRONIC (HOME-BASED) CLASS IIA LOE: EXPERT OPINION CLASS 1 LOE: MODERATE Torsemide, a potent and longer-acting loop diuretic, may be used to treat dogs no longer adequately responsive to furosemide.

paragraphs.id: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-p00045
paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s030
paragraphs.text: Furosemide (or torsemide) dosage should be increased as needed to decrease the accumulation of pulmonary edema or body cavity effusions.

paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s030
paragraphs.text: Pimobendan dosage is increased by some panelists to include a third 0.3 mg/kg daily dose.

paragraphs.sectionId: acvim-ACVIM-2019-犬MMVD-分期与治疗-官方摘要卡片-s030
